Job Description: 
Required a results-driven Senior Data Engineer with experience in designing, developing, and delivering enterprise-scale data engineering solutions across data warehousing, big data, and cloud platforms.

Key Responsibilities & Leadership -
•	Design and implement enterprise-scale data architectures, including Data Warehouses and Data Lakes.
•	Build and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines for analytics, reporting, and operational workloads.
•	Lead end-to-end data migration and modernisation programs from legacy systems to Hadoop, Spark, Databricks, and AWS platforms using Agile methodology.
•	Define and execute migration strategies, including data analysis, mapping, transformation, integration, validation, reconciliation, and production deployment.
•	Design and optimise data models, SQL queries, and Spark workloads to improve performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
•	Develop automation solutions to reduce manual effort and improve operational efficiency.
•	Ensure data quality, consistency, governance, and compliance across enterprise data platforms.
•	Perform data profiling, validation, and reconciliation to ensure accuracy and reliability of data assets.
•	Lead technical design reviews, architecture discussions, and code reviews to ensure adherence to best practices and standards.
•	Manage full project lifecycle delivery, including requirements gathering, design, development, testing, deployment, and production support.
•	Collaborate with architects, business analysts, product owners, and clients to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
•	Lead and mentor data engineering teams, including task allocation, skill development, and performance management.
•	Identify and resolve technical and delivery blockers to ensure timely project execution.
•	Manage stakeholder expectations and communicate technical solutions clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
•	Deliver both new development and production support projects in enterprise environments.
•	Continuously improve systems by identifying opportunities for performance, scalability, and cost optimisation.
•	Adapt quickly to new technologies, including AI-enabled data platforms, modern data engineering tools, and evolving coding methodologies.
•	Apply modern coding practices, including modular design, reusable components, version control standards, and CI/CD-aligned development approaches.
•	Maintain a strong continuous learning mindset and ability to work across evolving data and AI-driven ecosystems.
•	Strong domain expertise in banking domain.
Technical Skills -
•	Data Engineering & Platforms:  Data Warehousing, Data Lakes, ETL/ELT, Data Pipelines, Data Modelling, Data Profiling, Data Migration, Data Modernisation, Data Quality, Data Governance
•	Databases: SQL, Teradata, Oracle, DB2, Vertica, PostgreSQL, Amazon Redshift
•	Big Data Technologies: Hadoop ecosystem (HDFS, Hive, Hive SQL), Apache Spark, Spark SQL, PySpark
•	Cloud & Modern Data Platforms: AWS/Azure/GCP, Databricks/Snowflake/DBT
•	Programming & Scripting: Python, UNIX Shell Scripting
•	CI/CD: GitHub/ Jenkins

Construction Project Manager – Sydney CBD 

Kogan People Solutions is working with a leading provider of advisory, project and asset management services across the entire infrastructure spectrum. This respected entity offers integrated solutions across social, commercial, transport, utilities and defence infrastructure. Their teams have worked with many of Australia’s most influential brands and institutions from the government/ private and not-for-profit sectors, delivering city shaping and nation-building infrastructure. 

They now seek a Construction Project Manager to manage a multitude of projects and will enjoy a reporting line to members of the senior project team. The role is full time, and ongoing. 

The entity is the result of a recent merger of two successful significant respected entities; collectively they enjoy relationships with many clients who hold them in the highest regard. 

This is a great place to work…. join them! 

This vital position will provide the delivery of high-quality project management services: 

•	Sydney inner city location 

•	Salary negotiable in the range $100k to $110k plus superannuation per annum 

•	Excellent dynamics, friendly and supportive close team culture 

•	Excellent long term career path and team culture 

•	Much client contact and engagement (including bids, tenders, and proposals) 


 Location (work base) 

Sydney CBD  


 Responsibilities  

•	Project management of existing and new construction projects. 

•	Coordinating tenders for new construction projects. 

•	Developing relationships with both existing and new clients. 

•	Co-ordinating sub-contractors to ensure projects are completed in a timely manner. 

•	Liaising with client’s architects and other interested parties. 

•	Overseeing construction projects to ensure high standard of work is maintained. 

•	Coordinating labour and materials. 

•	Managing / overseeing budget / costs programme. 

•	Interpreting drawings and specifications. 

•	Communicating broadly and effectively across the firm and ensure all internal parties are kept informed of key developments in projects including potential issues requiring escalation. 

•	Presenting as a positive brand ambassador for the firm.   

Required experience, skills and qualifications required to be considered for this opportunity:  

 •	You will ideally demonstrate previous Project Management experience (at least 1 years post qualified, preferably much more) within a similar commercial development and construction environment. 

•	You will be competent with reading and understanding detailed construction plans, documents, and agreements in accordance with construction codes and standards. 

•	You will have strong industry knowledge in construction. 

•	We would expect at least a bachelor’s degree in a highly relevant subject area, or agreed alternative. 

•	Excellent client skills and empathy. 

•	Well-developed communication skills. 

•	Commitment to improving your professional knowledge. 

You must have unrestricted Australian working rights to be considered for this role.

Applications: Please send your details and covering letter to our recruiters Kogan People Solutions, quoting reference number 6182, using the contact details on this site. 

Please note we will only be able to notify shortlisted applicants.

With over a decade of success and innovation, they’re expanding into Australia and the wider Asia Pacific market. Now they’re looking for a visionary General Manager to lead the charge.

•	Location: Sydney 2000

•	Tenure: Full-time | Executive Leadership

•	Salary: Generous salary package $175k to $185k plus applicable super per annum

Headquartered in Vietnam, our client has built a reputation for transforming logistics operations with scalable, technology-driven solutions that boost efficiency, reduce costs, and create long-term competitive advantage. Clients include major supermarket chains, distributors, and e-commerce leaders across Southeast Asia—and now, they’re ready to go global.

Responsibilities and deliverables 

As General Manager, you’ll be the architect of our client’s regional growth. This is a hands-on, high-impact leadership role where you’ll:

•	Launch & Scale: Lead market entry strategy and build operations across Australia and the region.

•	Establish Presence: Set up offices, teams, and business units from the ground up.

•	Drive Growth: Identify and secure major clients in retail, wholesale, distribution, and e-commerce.

•	Build a Team: Recruit, mentor, and lead a high-performing local workforce.

•	Deliver Excellence: Oversee implementation of logistics, warehousing, and transportation solutions.

•	Ensure Compliance: You’ll need to be on top of Australian business, tax, and labour regulations

•	Own Relationships: Manage senior client partnerships and enterprise-level engagements.

•	Forge Alliances: Develop strategic partnerships with tech vendors, consultants, and 3PLs.

•	Be the Brand: Represent our client at industry events and forums as a thought leader.

•	Lead Financials: Own P&L, budgeting, KPI tracking, and cost control for the region.

•	Report Globally: Collaborate closely with HQ in Vietnam and report to global leadership.

To be considered, you will need to offer the following skills and attributes:

•	At least 5 years of proven strategic leadership and business expansion experience in Southeast Asia (and at least 1 or more years professional experience at similar high impact levels)

•	Deep expertise in warehouse automation and logistics technologies (WMS, ERP, TMS, SaaS-based delivery systems)

•	Strong track record in supply chain cost optimization and KPI management across SE Asia.

•	Skilled in stakeholder engagement and cross-cultural communication, especially within Southeast Asian markets

•	Data-driven decision maker with hands-on experience using tools like Power BI and ERP/WMS platforms

•	Be a native (or highly competent) Vietnamese speaker with fluent English skills (written and spoken)

•	Hold a bachelor’s degree or higher in Business, Logistics, Supply Chain, or related field

•	Certified in Leadership Development, Logistics Management, and trained in International Supply Chain Operations

•	Commercially savvy with strong client relationship skills

•	Comfortable building from scratch and leading cross-functional teams

•	Strategic thinker with hands-on execution capability

Kogan People Solutions are grateful for all applications, but kindly note that they will only respond to shortlisted applicants.

About Us
We are a rapidly growing engineering consulting firm with over 15 years of specialized expertise in structural, civil and stormwater engineering. We deliver precision engineering design and documentation services for residential (low to mid-rise), commercial, industrial and modular buildings across New South Wales.
Our reputation has been built on technical excellence, attention to detail and seamless collaboration with architects, developers, builders and consultants. Our mission is to provide practical, efficient and innovative engineering solutions that stand the test of time.
The Role
An exciting opportunity has become available for a Stormwater Engineer to join our growing team in Sydney.
You will be responsible for preparing stormwater management designs and supporting documentation for residential and commercial developments, while working closely with our structural and civil engineering teams.
The ideal candidate is motivated, detail-oriented, able to manage multiple projects, and committed to delivering high-quality engineering solutions.
Key Responsibilities
•	Prepare stormwater drainage designs for residential, commercial and industrial developments.
•	Design On-Site Detention (OSD), rainwater harvesting and stormwater management systems.
•	Prepare Stormwater Management Reports (SMR) and supporting engineering documentation.
•	Liaise with councils, architects, builders, certifiers and other consultants.
•	Assist with Development Application (DA) and Construction Certificate (CC) submissions.
•	Ensure designs comply with Australian Standards, council requirements and relevant engineering guidelines.
•	Coordinate with structural and civil engineers throughout project delivery.
•	Assist with project planning and delivery within required timeframes.
Key Requirements
•	Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or related discipline.
•	Experience in stormwater engineering and drainage design.
•	Proficient in AutoCAD.
•	Experience with Drains, MUSIC, DRAINS, HEC-RAS or other stormwater modelling software is highly regarded.
•	Good understanding of Australian Standards, Australian Rainfall & Runoff (ARR), and local council stormwater requirements.
•	Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
•	Excellent communication and organisational skills.
•	Ability to work both independently and within a team.
•	Attention to detail and commitment to producing high-quality work.
•	Need minimum 1.5 years working experience
•	Current Australian Driver Licence is preferred.
•	Visa status: Australian Citizen, Permanent Resident (PR), or full working rights in Australia.
What We Offer
•	Competitive salary based on experience.
•	Professional development and ongoing training.
•	Opportunity to work on a diverse range of engineering projects.
•	Supportive and collaborative team environment.
•	Career progression within a growing engineering consultancy.
•	Salary packaging.

Seven Corp on behalf of Reofast


Overview: 

Reofast supplies, fabricates and installs reinforcing steel for premium residential builders across Perth, taking projects from take-off and quotation through to fabrication, delivery and installation. The business is committed to delivering high-quality reinforcement solutions through accuracy, efficiency and exceptional customer service.

We are seeking an experienced Construction Estimator to join our team in Perth, WA. In this role, you will be responsible for analysing structural and architectural drawings, preparing quantity take-offs and cost estimates, and developing reinforcement schedules and bar lists to support the accurate supply, fabrication and delivery of reinforcement steel products. This is a full-time ongoing position working 38 hours per week.


Main tasks:

-	Analysing structural and architectural drawings to determine reinforcement steel requirements for construction projects.
-	Preparing detailed quantity take-offs and cost estimates for steel supply, fabrication and delivery.
-	Developing reinforcement schedules and bar lists to ensure quantities align with structural and engineering drawings.
-	Preparing pricing breakdowns for materials, fabrication and logistics to support quotations and tender submissions.
-	Coordinating with structural engineers, architects, builders, site teams and suppliers to confirm project requirements, quantities and pricing.
-	Reviewing project variations and updating estimates, quantities and costs accordingly.
-	Preparing marked-up drawings and maintaining accurate estimating information across internal software systems.
-	Managing workload, priorities and deadlines to ensure quotations and reinforcement schedules are completed on time.
-	Liaising with clients and builders to ensure estimating is based on the latest project documentation.
-	Monitoring stock levels and assisting with supplier orders as required.
-	Maintaining accurate estimating records and reports.
-	Performing any additional duties as required from time to time.


Required/Relevant Qualifications & Work Experience:

-	Relevant qualification in Construction, Building, Engineering or a related discipline.
-	Alternatively, at least five years of relevant construction estimating experience may substitute for the formal qualification.


Required/Relevant Skills & Knowledge:

-	Strong communication skills with clients, staff and site tradespersons.
-	High attention to detail and accuracy.
-	Ability to read and interpret structural and architectural drawings.
-	Sound understanding of construction site operations and project requirements.
-	Ability to prepare accurate reinforcement schedules within required timeframes.
-	Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage priorities, workloads and deadlines.
-	Ability to build and maintain effective relationships with clients and suppliers.
-	Solutions-focused with a proactive and can-do attitude.
-	Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Notion and Slack.
-	Ability to maintain accurate estimating records and reports.


 Annual salary will be between $90,000.00 to $110,000.00 (plus superannuation) depending on level of experience.

We provide safe and equitable care, for every stage of life, delivered with world-leading expertise and over 175 years of experience. 


As a leading academic health service, we're committed to providing tomorrow's care today by integrating research, teaching and training into everyday practice. 


Our team of 24,000 people are full hearted, open minded and all in. Together, we provide more than 250 integrated services for every stage of life at over 50 locations and in the community across south-east Melbourne, Victoria, serving 1.2 million residents in the South Metro Local Health Service Network. 


To see first-hand what our colleagues think about working here, take a look at the following short videos monashhealth.org-careers.








Application Architect




Care, reimagined


Design and deliver innovative learning that builds clinical digital capability


Permanent, full time role, hybrid workplace model




Make a Difference Through Digital Health



About The Design & Architecture Services Team.




The Design & Architecture Services Team provides organisation-wide architecture governance and solution design leadership. The team partners with operational, clinical and technical stakeholders to ensure technology decisions support strategic goals, reduce risk and create a cohesive digital ecosystem.






About The Role



As Application Architect, you will provide specialised architectural leadership for Microsoft application platforms across Monash Health. You will establish standards, provide architectural assurance and guide the safe, governed and effective use of Microsoft technologies including Power Platform and Microsoft 365. Working closely with Digital Applications teams, Cyber Security, IT Operations and business stakeholders, you will help ensure solutions are sustainable, supportable and aligned with enterprise architecture principles while enabling innovation across the organisation. 




What We're Looking For



You are an experienced Application Architect who thrives at the intersection of innovation, governance and business enablement. You bring deep expertise across Microsoft 365, Power Platform and modern application architecture, with the ability to balance creativity and agility with the controls required in a complex, highly regulated environment. You have extensive experience designing and governing solutions using Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Pages and Dataverse, and understand how these technologies can be applied to deliver meaningful business outcomes while maintaining security, compliance and sustainability.



You'll Also Bring:





Extensive experience designing and governing Microsoft 365 and Power Platform solutions.


Strong understanding of application architecture, platform governance and enterprise standards.


Experience working within highly regulated and complex environments.


Ability to provide practical architectural guidance to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.


A passion for enabling innovation while maintaining strong governance and control frameworks. 






Experience in healthcare or digital health is highly regarded.




Why join Monash Health?



This is more than a digital role-it's your chance to transform healthcare at scale. Working at the intersection of clinical care, technology and innovation, you'll help create smarter digital solutions that improve patient outcomes and support the clinicians who deliver them every day




At Monash Health, you will:






Lead a state-wide service with real impact


Work within a values-driven, purpose-led organisation


Be part of a connected network of clinical, academic and system leaders


Help drive innovation, inclusion and better health outcomes








We also offer:






The opportunity to make a real impact on patient experience


A supportive, collaborative team environment


Ongoing learning and development opportunities


The chance to be part of Victoria's largest public health service






For a confidential discussion and to explore this opportunity further, please reach out to Robert Dashwood by email- Robert.Dashwoodo@monashhealth.org

Our Culture and Values 



At Monash Health, our people are at the heart of everything we do. Our culture is inclusive, supportive and future-focused, underpinned by clear values and a commitment to continuous improvement. 



Our teams play a critical role in bringing our new strategy to life, challenging traditional approaches, embracing innovation, and ensuring every appointment reflects our commitment to equity, transparency and excellence. 



You'll be encouraged to share ideas, contribute to improvement initiatives, and grow alongside experienced professionals who are passionate about what they do. 




We are Full Hearted, Open Minded and All In, enabling excellent service delivery and a positive candidate and employee experience every time. 



We recognise the value of equal employment opportunity. We are committed to patient safety, promoting fairness, equity and diversity in the workplace and to Child Safe Standards. 




If you're passionate about helping clinicians embrace digital innovation and want to influence the future of healthcare at scale, we'd love to hear from you.
